name: AAA Spring Specialist Inc
old_description: 1968 AAA Spring has been Utah's #1 suspension products and installation
about:
Founded in 1968 in Salt Lake City, Utah, AAA Spring Specialist Inc began as a suspension products and installation shop serving the Intermountain West. The company has remained a locally operated business for over five decades, building a reputation as Utah’s largest supplier of leaf springs and heavy-duty suspension components.

The company operates a full-service installation and repair facility where every vehicle receives a complimentary suspension inspection. Its on-site warehouse stocks what it describes as the Intermountain West’s largest selection of suspension parts, including leaf springs, air springs, helper kits, Timbren Suspension Enhancement Systems, add-a-leaf kits, bushings, U-bolts, shackles, hangers, shocks, torque rods, and a range of brake components such as drums, overhaul kits, relined shoes, spring brakes, and air-system parts. Custom leaf spring fabrication is also offered.

AAA Spring serves heavy-duty truck fleets, construction equipment operators, and light-duty pickup owners across Utah, Idaho, Colorado, Nevada, Arizona, and New Mexico. Its customer base includes commercial fleets, independent repair shops, and individual vehicle owners seeking suspension upgrades, repairs, or load-capacity increases.

The business emphasizes its four-decade tenure as Utah’s leading leaf-spring supplier, its free full-suspension inspection policy, and its extensive on-site inventory as key differentiators. These factors, it says, have fostered long-lasting relationships and a trusted name throughout the region.
